source: No email app found to send feedback
text: Teu aya surélék aplikasi kapanggih ka kirim eupan balik

source: Could not use picture: camera file
text: Teu bisa paké gambar: kaméra berkas

source: Offline — no known stations in range. Enter place manually.
text: Teu nyambung — henteu dipikanyaho stations di jangkoan. Asupkeun tempat manually.
Teu aya stations kapanggih within %1$s m

source: The database couldn't be opened or upgraded from schema %1$s to %2$s;
text: pangkalan data couldn't jadi opened atawa upgraded ti schema %1$s ka %2$s;

source: This permanently deletes all vehicles, fuel and expense records on this device.
text: Ieu langgeng deletes sadayana kandaraan, bensin jeung waragad records dina ieu alat.

source: Export first with: %1$s. This cannot be undone.
text: Ékspor kahiji jeung: %1$s. Ieu teu bisa jadi undone.

source: stale transfer staging couldn't be removed
text: stale transfer staging couldn't jadi removed

source: Tap the currency symbol on amount to change currency.
text: Toél duit symbol dina amount ka ganti duit.

source: Time is now (default on create) stamps the save time; uncheck to pick date/time.
text: Waktos nyaéta ayeuna (baku dina jieun) stamps simpen waktos; uncheck ka cokot tanggal/waktos.

source: Manage categories… stays pinned at the bottom of the category menu
text: Ngatur golongan… stays pinned di bottom ti golongan menu

source: (scroll the list above if long; select a vehicle first).
text: (scroll daptar above lamun panjang; pilih kandaraan kahiji).
Teu nyambung — tempat lookup nalika nyambung

source: No place found (will retry after save if online)
text: Teu aya tempat kapanggih (bakal cobian deui sanggeus simpen lamun nyambung)

source: Receipt is in cloud backup only
text: Kuitansi nyaéta di awan cadangan ukur

source: Tap a card to edit. Add from Menu → New expense, or Reports hub.
text: Toél kartu ka édit. Tambahkeun ti Menu → Anyar waragad, atawa Laporan hub.

source: First item is the new-expense default. Renames/deletes do not rewrite past expense Category strings.
text: Kahiji barang nyaéta anyar-waragad baku. Renames/deletes pigawé henteu rewrite past waragad Golongan strings.
Pangukur jarak: %1$s (disimpen tracking). Pariksa, tuluy Simpen.

source: Dash captured. Enter odometer if needed, or switch to pump.
text: Dasbor captured. Asupkeun pangukur jarak lamun diperlukeun, atawa alihkeun ka pompa.

source: Pump photo captured. Enter cost/volume if needed, then Save.
text: Pompa poto captured. Asupkeun harga/ukuran lamun diperlukeun, tuluy Simpen.
Teu nyambung — henteu dipikanyaho stasion nearby

source: Aim at odometer. Tap shutter to capture.
text: Aim di pangukur jarak. Toél panutup ka candak.

source: White circle — shutter (capture dash or pump).
text: White circle — panutup (candak dasbor atawa pompa).

source: Disk — save the fill when fields are ready.
text: Disk — simpen ngeusi nalika widang nyaéta siap.
↕ — alihkeun pangukur jarak modeu ↔ pompa (harga/ukuran) modeu.

source: Type odo/cost/volume anytime (custom keypad). Menu → Help for the full walkthrough.
text: Jenis odo/harga/ukuran anytime (husus keypad). Menu → Pitulung pikeun full walkthrough.
Teu aya kaméra dina ieu alat

source: Error: Image buffer is not direct
text: Kasalahan: Gambar buffer nyaéta henteu direct

source: Photo save failed — entry will have no photo
text: Poto simpen gagal — entry bakal boga henteu poto

source: Could not save fuel photo to gallery: %1$s
text: Teu bisa simpen bensin poto ka galéri: %1$s

source: Aim at pump display (cost/volume). Tap shutter to capture.
text: Aim di pompa témbongkeun (harga/ukuran). Toél panutup ka candak.

source: Per-vehicle tabs list fuel fills only (trip starts are under Reports → Trip miles).
text: Unggal-kandaraan tabs daptar bensin ngeusi ukur (lalampahan mitembeyan nyaéta handapeun Laporan → Lalampahan mil).

source: Tap a row to edit. Missing photos can be fetched from archive when cloud identity exists.
text: Toél baris ka édit. Leungit poto bisa jadi fetched ti arsip nalika awan identity exists.

source: Per-vehicle fills (no trip starts). Tap a card to edit. Thumbnails fetch from archive when missing locally.
text: Unggal-kandaraan ngeusi (henteu lalampahan mitembeyan). Toél kartu ka édit. Thumbnails cokot ti arsip nalika leungit locally.

source: No fuel entries for this vehicle
text: Teu aya bensin entries pikeun ieu kandaraan

source: Short on-device guide so you can start immediately. For screenshots and every step, open the full illustrated manual (bundled in the app — works offline, no GitHub login).
text: Short dina-alat guide jadi anjeun bisa mitembeyan immediately. Pikeun screenshots jeung unggal léngkah, buka full illustrated leungeun (bundled di aplikasi — works teu nyambung, henteu GitHub login).

source: Short step-by-step walkthroughs with screenshots (offline). Also offered on first run when you have no vehicles.
text: Short léngkah-ku-léngkah walkthroughs jeung screenshots (teu nyambung). Ogé offered dina kahiji jalankeun nalika anjeun boga henteu kandaraan.

source: Connect existing setup = join another device’s shared sheet + photo folder (not create a new blank sheet).
text: Sambungkeun existing setélan = join séjén alat’s shared lembar + poto polder (henteu jieun anyar kosong lembar).

source: ⓘ (title bar) — page help for the current screen (stays while you stay on the page)
text: ⓘ (judul bar) — kaca pitulung pikeun current layar (stays while anjeun stay dina kaca)

source: ! (red, title bar) — last spreadsheet or photo sync failed; opens Syncing
text: ! (red, judul bar) — panungtung lembar itungan atawa poto nyaluyukeun gagal; opens Nyaluyukeun

source: ?N (title bar) — open Import / Review questions when items need answers
text: ?N (judul bar) — buka Impor / Pariksa patarosan nalika items need answers

source: White circle — shutter (capture dash, pump, or receipt)
text: White circle — panutup (candak dasbor, pompa, atawa kuitansi)

source: ↕ on Fill — switch odometer mode ↔ pump (cost/volume) mode
text: ↕ dina Ngeusi — alihkeun pangukur jarak modeu ↔ pompa (harga/ukuran) modeu

source: ↔ between cost and volume — swap the two values if OCR swapped them
text: ↔ between harga jeung ukuran — swap two values lamun OCR swapped them

source: 🔍 on sync forms — browse Google Drive for a sheet or folder
text: 🔍 dina nyaluyukeun forms — nyungsi Google Drive pikeun lembar atawa polder

source: Menu → Manage Vehicles → Vehicle dropdown → Add New Vehicle
text: Menu → Ngatur Kandaraan → Kandaraan dropdown → Tambahkeun Anyar Kandaraan

source: Take or pick a clear dashboard photo
text: Take atawa cokot beresihan dashboard poto

source: Run Discovery, Select Odo, tap the seed, adjust, Save
text: Jalankeun Discovery, Pilih Odo, toél seed, adjust, Simpen

source: Run Discovery, review landmarks (Edit OCR to fix misses), enter a Vehicle Name
text: Jalankeun Discovery, pariksa landmarks (Édit OCR ka lereskeun misses), asupkeun Kandaraan Ngaran

source: Landmarks power auto vehicle match on Fill. No camera? Type odo/volume/cost by hand.
text: Landmarks power otomatis kandaraan cocog dina Ngeusi. Henteu kaméra? Jenis odo/ukuran/harga ku hand.

source: Open the app (Fill is home) — no need to pick the vehicle first
text: Buka aplikasi (Ngeusi nyaéta home) — henteu need ka cokot kandaraan kahiji

source: Aim at the odometer → shutter → confirm Odo (vehicle auto-detects from landmarks)
text: Aim di pangukur jarak → panutup → pastikeun Odo (kandaraan otomatis-detects ti landmarks)

source: Tap ↕ for pump mode → aim at pump totals → shutter
text: Toél ↕ pikeun pompa modeu → aim di pompa totals → panutup

source: Fix fields if needed (tap currency or G/L to change units)
text: Lereskeun widang lamun diperlukeun (toél duit atawa G/L ka ganti units)

source: Disk (Save). Blank fields are allowed as a partial fill. Works offline
text: Disk (Simpen). Kosong widang nyaéta allowed salaku partial ngeusi. Works teu nyambung

source: Shutter or gallery for the receipt; fill vendor, amount, category, vehicle
text: Panutup atawa galéri pikeun kuitansi; ngeusi padagang, amount, golongan, kandaraan

source: Save. Open expenses from Reports → Expenses list to review or edit later
text: Simpen. Buka waragad ti Laporan → Waragad daptar ka pariksa atawa édit engké

source: Menu → Reports — hub summary, then report cards
text: Menu → Laporan — hub summary, tuluy laporan cards

source: Time based reports — one plot with independent Y scales (mpg and G/mi on the left; $ / trip miles / trip %% by type on the right),
text: Waktos based laporan — hiji plot jeung independent Y scales (mpg jeung G/mi dina kénca; $ / lalampahan mil / lalampahan %% ku jenis dina katuhu),

source: Fill history lists fills only; Trip miles has the trip-start list (tap a row to edit)
text: Ngeusi sajarah lists ngeusi ukur; Lalampahan mil boga lalampahan-mitembeyan daptar (toél baris ka édit)

source: Fuel History and edit screens can Fetch image from archive when any photo destination has the file
text: Bensin Sajarah jeung édit screens bisa Cokot gambar ti arsip nalika any poto tujuan boga berkas

source: Use your own accounts — not a shared app cloud. Sync is background; no network needed to add fills.
text: Paké anjeun own rekening — henteu shared aplikasi awan. Nyaluyukeun nyaéta latar; henteu jaringan diperlukeun ka tambahkeun ngeusi.

source: Settings → Spreadsheet sync: Google Sheets, Excel, EtherCalc, or Other (Baserow, NocoDB, Airtable, PocketBase, Supabase, Firebase, Zoho Sheet, …)
text: Setélan → Lembar itungan nyaluyukeun: Google Lembar, Excel, EtherCalc, atawa Séjén (Baserow, NocoDB, Airtable, PocketBase, Supabase, Firebase, Zoho Lembar, …)

source: Settings → Photo backup: Google Drive, OneDrive, S3, or Other (WebDAV/SFTP/… via rclone)
text: Setélan → Poto cadangan: Google Drive, OneDrive, S3, atawa Séjén (WebDAV/SFTP/… via rclone)

source: Full provider list and setup: online manual or self-host index.
text: Full provider daptar jeung setélan: nyambung leungeun atawa self-host index.

source: Red error under Spreadsheet sync / Photo backup in Settings
text: Red kasalahan handapeun Lembar itungan nyaluyukeun / Poto cadangan di Setélan

source: Red ! in the title bar → Settings
Yellow ? in the title bar → Import / Review questions
text: Yellow? di judul bar → Impor / Pariksa patarosan

source: Same fill entered twice on two devices = two rows; delete the extra
text: Sarua ngeusi entered twice dina two devices = two baris; hapus tambahan

source: Import Old Pictures and experiment screens are advanced tools and are not covered here.
text: Impor Heubeul Gambar jeung experiment screens nyaéta maju tools jeung nyaéta henteu covered here.

source: Batch import references your existing dash/pump photo files in place (does not copy them).
text: Batch impor references anjeun existing dasbor/pompa poto berkas di tempat (does henteu salin them).

source: No vehicles yet. Choose stand-alone (add a vehicle on this phone) or connect to an existing multi-device setup (same sheet + photo folder).
text: Teu aya kandaraan acan. Pilih stand-alone (tambahkeun kandaraan dina ieu télépon) atawa sambungkeun ka existing multi-alat setélan (sarua lembar + poto polder).

source: You can skip and use Fill manually; this screen returns on the next start until a vehicle exists.
text: Anjeun tiasa ngalewatan sareng ngeusian ku panangan; ieu layar datang deui dina ngamimitian salajengna dugi aya kandaraan.

source: You don’t have a vehicle yet. How do you want to start?
text: Anjeun don’t boga kandaraan acan. How pigawé anjeun want ka mitembeyan?

source: This phone is stand-alone / first vehicle
text: Ieu télépon nyaéta stand-alone / kahiji kandaraan

source: Another device already has the app — join that sheet + photo folder
text: Séjén alat geus boga aplikasi — join éta lembar + poto polder

source: You can enter fills by hand. This welcome screen returns next launch until you add a vehicle.
text: Anjeun bisa asupkeun ngeusi ku hand. Ieu wilujeng sumping layar returns salajengna launch until anjeun tambahkeun kandaraan.

source: From the menu (☰), choose Manage Vehicles. This is where you create dashboards
text: Ti menu (☰), pilih Ngatur Kandaraan. Ieu nyaéta where anjeun jieun dashboards

source: Open the vehicle dropdown and pick Add New Vehicle. You are setting up this phone
text: Buka kandaraan dropdown jeung cokot Tambahkeun Anyar Kandaraan. Anjeun nyaéta setting luhur ieu télépon

source: as stand-alone / first vehicle (or an additional vehicle).
text: salaku stand-alone / kahiji kandaraan (atawa additional kandaraan).

source: Take or pick a clear photo of the instrument cluster. Good lighting and a square-on
text: Take atawa cokot beresihan poto ti instrument cluster. Good lighting jeung square-dina

source: view of the odometer help discovery.
text: tingali ti pangukur jarak pitulung discovery.

source: Run Discovery, Select Odo, tap the seed, adjust, Save.
text: Jalankeun Discovery, Pilih Odo, toél seed, adjust, Simpen.

source: Review landmarks. Edit OCR text if something was missed.
text: Pariksa landmarks. Édit OCR text lamun something baheula missed.

source: Enter a Vehicle Name, then Create Vehicle. After at least one user vehicle exists,
text: Asupkeun Kandaraan Ngaran, tuluy Jieun Kandaraan. Sanggeus di least hiji pamaké kandaraan exists,

source: the first-run splash will not appear again.
text: kahiji-jalankeun splash bakal henteu appear deui.

source: This path is for a **new phone or tablet** joining an **existing** Vehicle Expenses setup.
text: Ieu jalur nyaéta pikeun **anyar télépon atawa tablet** joining **existing** Kandaraan Waragad setélan.

source: Another device already has vehicles, a **shared spreadsheet**, and usually a **shared photo folder**.
text: Séjén alat geus boga kandaraan, **shared lembar itungan**, jeung usually **shared poto polder**.

source: You use **your** Google / Microsoft / other account — not an app-hosted cloud.
text: Anjeun paké **anjeun** Google / Microsoft / séjén rekening — henteu aplikasi-hosted awan.

source: Stand-alone first setup (no other device yet) is **Add a vehicle**, not this tutorial.
text: Stand-alone kahiji setélan (henteu séjén alat acan) nyaéta **Tambahkeun kandaraan**, henteu ieu tutorial.

source: From the menu (☰), open **Syncing**. You will add destinations that point at the **same**
text: Ti menu (☰), buka **Nyaluyukeun**. Anjeun bakal tambahkeun tujuan éta point di **sarua**

source: sheet and photo folder the other device already uses — not brand-new empty ones.
text: lembar jeung poto polder séjén alat geus uses — henteu brand-anyar kosong ones.

source: Spreadsheet: open the existing shared file
text: Lembar itungan: buka existing shared berkas

source: Add a spreadsheet destination → pick the same provider as the other device (often Google Sheets) →
text: Tambahkeun lembar itungan tujuan → cokot sarua provider salaku séjén alat (often Google Lembar) →

source: sign in. Paste the **existing sheet URL** from the other phone (or Drive **browse to that file**).
text: asup. Témpél **existing lembar URL** ti séjén télépon (atawa Drive **nyungsi ka éta berkas**).

source: Test connection, then **Sync now** to pull vehicles and rows.
text: Uji connection, tuluy **Nyaluyukeun ayeuna** ka pull kandaraan jeung baris.

source: **Do not Create** a new blank spreadsheet for this path (if the UI still offers Create, skip it).
text: **Pigawé henteu Jieun** anyar kosong lembar itungan pikeun ieu jalur (lamun UI still offers Jieun, léwatan éta).

source: Add a photo destination → same provider as the other device → sign in.
text: Tambahkeun poto tujuan → sarua provider salaku séjén alat → asup.

source: Choose the **same photo folder** already used by the cluster (URL or browse).
text: Pilih **sarua poto polder** geus used ku cluster (URL atawa nyungsi).

source: Test connection → Sync now. Vehicle reference images can download automatically;
text: Uji connection → Nyaluyukeun ayeuna. Kandaraan rujukan images bisa download automatically;

source: fill/receipt photos are on-demand via Fetch from archive.
text: ngeusi/kuitansi poto nyaéta dina-demand via Cokot ti arsip.

source: **Do not create a new empty folder** for this path.
text: **Pigawé henteu jieun anyar kosong polder** pikeun ieu jalur.

source: Vehicles and data should appear from the shared sheet. Only then, if a vehicle is missing
text: Kandaraan jeung data should appear ti shared lembar. Ukur tuluy, lamun kandaraan nyaéta leungit

source: a local dash photo, open Manage Vehicles and capture or fetch the reference image.
text: lokal dasbor poto, buka Ngatur Kandaraan jeung candak atawa cokot rujukan gambar.

source: You do not need to re-type the whole fleet from scratch.
text: Anjeun pigawé henteu need ka re-jenis whole fleet ti scratch.

source: Keep local and leave the sheet
Keep local and write it back
text: Simpen lokal jeung write éta balik

source: Create Firestore collections with string fields matching app headers (Sync ID first).
text: Jieun Firestore collections jeung string widang matching aplikasi headers (Nyaluyukeun Idéntitas kahiji).

source: Use a short-lived ID token or power-user access token — never ship unrestricted service accounts in the APK.
text: Paké short-lived Idéntitas token atawa power-pamaké aksés token — teu pernah ship unrestricted service rekening di APK.

source: No items visible. With Drive access limited to this app, open or create files here first.
text: Teu aya items katingali. Jeung Drive aksés limited ka ieu aplikasi, buka atawa jieun berkas here kahiji.

source: No spreadsheets found. Try search, or paste a sheet URL if it is shared with your account.
text: Teu aya lembar itungan kapanggih. Cobian milarian, atawa témpél lembar URL lamun éta nyaéta shared jeung anjeun rekening.

source: No folders found. Try search, or paste a folder URL if it is shared with your account.
text: Teu aya polder kapanggih. Cobian milarian, atawa témpél polder URL lamun éta nyaéta shared jeung anjeun rekening.

source: %1$s created or opened in this app.
text: %1$s created atawa opened di ieu aplikasi.

source: All %1$s your Google account can view, including shared files.
text: Sadayana %1$s anjeun Google rekening bisa tingali, including shared berkas.

source: Allow Drive read access to list all %1$s (owned and shared with you).
text: Idinan Drive baca aksés ka daptar sadayana %1$s (owned jeung shared jeung anjeun).

source: Sign-in failed — try again or pick a Google account with Drive access
text: Asup-di gagal — cobian deui atawa cokot Google rekening jeung Drive aksés

source: Drive browse access not granted — try again
text: Drive nyungsi aksés henteu granted — cobian deui

source: Paste a link or use browse
No folders visible. Create one here or open an existing folder in this app first.
text: Teu aya polder katingali. Jieun hiji here atawa buka existing polder di ieu aplikasi kahiji.

source: S3 and compatible services (Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, …).
text: S3 jeung compatible services (Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, …).

source: Required for MinIO and custom S3-compatible hosts
text: Diperlukeun pikeun MinIO jeung husus S3-compatible hosts

source: Photos upload under this path on your signed-in OneDrive.
text: Poto upload handapeun ieu jalur dina anjeun geus asup-di OneDrive.

source: Create a remote on this device or pick one from the conf. Powered by rclone for WebDAV, SFTP, Azure, and more.
text: Jieun jauh dina ieu alat atawa cokot hiji ti conf. Powered ku rclone pikeun WebDAV, SFTP, Azure, jeung leuwih.

source: Enter access key and secret, or save S3 credentials first
text: Asupkeun aksés konci jeung secret, atawa simpen S3 credentials kahiji

source: Create or select a remote first
Add Google Drive (or other) destinations. Sync now uploads vehicle refs and pending photos.
text: Tambahkeun Google Drive (atawa séjén) tujuan. Nyaluyukeun ayeuna uploads kandaraan refs jeung ngantosan poto.

source: Open a destination for Test connection and Sync now (this destination).
text: Buka tujuan pikeun Uji connection jeung Nyaluyukeun ayeuna (ieu tujuan).

source: Leaving the screen mid-sync does not cancel the backup.
text: Leaving layar mid-nyaluyukeun does henteu bolay cadangan.

source: Add a destination (Google Drive is common: Sign in with Google (Drive) → optional folder via 🔍 → save → Sync now). Manual sync runs all configured destinations; background backup runs enabled ones only.
text: Tambahkeun tujuan (Google Drive nyaéta common: ASUP jeung Google (Drive) → optional polder via 🔍 → simpen → Nyaluyukeun ayeuna). Leungeun nyaluyukeun runs sadayana configured tujuan; latar cadangan runs dihurungkeun ones ukur.

source: No remotes in this conf yet. Create one with +.
text: Teu aya remotes di ieu conf acan. Jieun hiji jeung +.

source: Could not open browser for sign-in
text: Teu bisa buka panyungsi pikeun asup-di

source: Requires browser sign-in. Complete authorization in the browser, then continue.
text: Requires panyungsi asup-di. Lengkep authorization di panyungsi, tuluy teruskeun.

source: Choose a category, then pick a backend. Import conf on the destination screen for advanced setups.
text: Pilih golongan, tuluy cokot backend. Impor conf dina tujuan layar pikeun maju setups.

source: No backends in this category. Try another kind or import rclone.conf.
text: Teu aya backends di ieu golongan. Cobian séjén kind atawa impor rclone.conf.

source: This backend needs browser OAuth. You can try guided sign-in below,
text: Ieu backend needs panyungsi OAuth. Anjeun bisa cobian guided asup-di below,

source: or use Import existing conf… for a desktop-built remote.
text: atawa paké Impor existing conf… pikeun desktop-built jauh.

source: No extra fields for %1$s. Save to add the remote.
text: Teu aya tambahan widang pikeun %1$s. Simpen ka tambahkeun jauh.

source: Create tables/collections with fields matching app headers (Sync ID first). Map table ids below.
text: Jieun tables/collections jeung widang matching aplikasi headers (Nyaluyukeun Idéntitas kahiji). Map table ids below.

source: Units, photo save toggles, debug Fill, and experiment screens live here.
text: Units, poto simpen toggles, debug Ngeusi, jeung experiment screens live here.

source: Spreadsheet and photo destinations are under Menu → Syncing (not only this page).
text: Lembar itungan jeung poto tujuan nyaéta handapeun Menu → Nyaluyukeun (henteu ukur ieu kaca).

source: Show experiment screens reveals Alignment, Pump Experiment, and Import Old Pictures in the drawer.
text: Témbongkeun experiment screens reveals Alignment, Pompa Experiment, jeung Impor Heubeul Gambar di drawer.

source: Photos permission denied. Grant Photos access in App info → Permissions so fuel photos can save to gallery.
text: Poto idin ditolak. Grant Poto aksés di Aplikasi info → Permissions jadi bensin poto bisa simpen ka galéri.

source: Sync & backup lives under Menu → Syncing (spreadsheet + photo destinations, Sync now, failures).
text: Nyaluyukeun & cadangan lives handapeun Menu → Nyaluyukeun (lembar itungan + poto tujuan, Nyaluyukeun ayeuna, gagal).
Teu nyambung: packaged samples → Unassigned bensin.

source: Live: Gmail label (OAuth) and/or generic IMAP folder (host + app password).
text: Live: Gmail label (OAuth) jeung/atawa generic IMAP polder (host + aplikasi sandi).

source: Same label/folder may hold multiple vendors; parser auto-detects.
text: Sarua label/polder may hold multiple vendors; parser otomatis-detects.

source: Rows: vehicle Unassigned (id 0), odometer 0, Partial Fill off.
text: Baris: kandaraan Unassigned (idéntitas 0), pangukur jarak 0, Partial Ngeusi off.

source: IMAP uses TLS (port 993). Passwords are not written to logcat.
text: IMAP uses TLS (port 993). Passwords nyaéta henteu written ka logcat.
Teu aya debug laporan ka kirim

source: First-run walkthroughs for adding a vehicle or connecting sync (also under Help).
text: Kahiji-jalankeun walkthroughs pikeun adding kandaraan atawa connecting nyaluyukeun (ogé handapeun Pitulung).

source: Label Y-band uses smallest value-cluster rect height × extra fraction (resolution-independent).
text: Label Y-band uses smallest nilai-cluster rect height × tambahan fraction (resolution-independent).

source: Ratio lo/hi are band-gated extreme checks (not a target $/gal).
text: Ratio lo/hi nyaéta band-gated extreme checks (henteu target $/gal).

source: Label Y-band extra (fraction of smallest value rect height, 0–1)
text: Label Y-band tambahan (fraction ti smallest nilai rect height, 0–1)

source: This captures images and OCR details during a fill that can be emailed for debugging.
text: Ieu captures images jeung OCR wincikan during ngeusi éta bisa jadi emailed pikeun debugging.

source: No email app found to send report
text: Teu aya surélék aplikasi kapanggih ka kirim laporan

source: Convert existing fuel volumes between G and L?
text: Convert existing bensin volumes between G jeung L?

source: If you choose No, historical numbers keep their current values but
text: Lamun anjeun pilih Henteu, historical numbers simpen maranéhna current values but

source: display labels will change without conversion.
